title: Finding a Job That Aligns with Your Values
description:
In this @teal_hq class, we'll talk about how to determine your values and your motivation—because so much of what enables you to have a fulfilling career is making sure that the work you're doing is aligned with your personal values and the things that motivate you. 

Here’s the agenda: 

1. Our approach and some of the things that we think about and the frameworks that Teal uses to think about this category
2. How to determine your values and a framework for thinking about values
3. How to pinpoint your motivations, what those things are that drive you
4. Using your values and motivation to define a vision of where you want to go next.

----------
00:00 | Introduction
00:53 | Teal's approach & framework (The career exploration process)
03:30 | How to determine your values?
13:07 | How to pinpoint your motivations? (What drives you?)
16:45 | Using your values and motivation to define a VISION of where you want to go next
21:38 | Wrapping up & conclusion
